Interface IMutableAbilityStore

All Superinterfaces:
IAbilityStore
All Known Subinterfaces:
IInitializableMutableAbilityStore
All Known Implementing Classes:
CompoundTagMutableAbilityStore, DefaultMutableAbilityStore, ItemDataMutableAbilityStore
public interface IMutableAbilityStore extends IAbilityStore
Extension of the IAbilityStore that allows insertion and deletion of abilities.
